log.msg: Qwen (qwen2.5-coder:7b) is designing the kitchen - under a minute
Applying the MagickHome rule book: module sizes for this kitchen size and shape
Applying design rules: window, door, corner and chimney clearances
Building the 3D scene: cabinets, appliances, countertops, panels

raw.room_reading: The room is a large U-shape with three solid walls and one wall with a door and window. The primary cooking wall is Wall 3, and the sink is on Wall 4. The floor area is 172 sqft, and the wall height is 2500 mm.
raw.design_plan: The design will feature a large U-shape layout with the hob on Wall 3 and the sink on Wall 4. The base cabinets will be a mix of shutters and drawers, with a focus on providing ample storage and a U-c
raw.layout_why: This layout maximizes space and provides easy access to all major kitchen functions, with the hob and sink centrally located in the U-shape.
raw.sink_why: The sink is on Wall 4, which is the customer's preference, and it provides easy access from both sides of the kitchen.
raw.hob_why: The hob is on Wall 3, which is the customer's choice and the primary cooking wall, ensuring optimal space and functionality.
raw.lpg_why: LPG is assumed, so the cylinder unit is included (rule R11).
raw.tall_why: The customer wants tall storage, so tall units will be placed above the wall cabinets.
raw.purifier_why: Water purifier is not stated, so it will be omitted.
raw.display_why: Glass display is not stated, so it will be omitted.
raw.open_why: Open shelf unit is not stated, so it will be omitted.
raw.storage_why: The customer wants tall storage, so wall cabinets and lofts will be included.
raw.features_why: Spice pullout and water purifier units will be included for convenience.
raw.wall_cabinets_why: Wall cabinets will be hinged shutters for easy access and aesthetics.
raw.wall_style_why: Hinged shutters will be used for the wall cabinets to provide easy access and aesthetics.
raw.finish_why: The customer did not specify finishes, so a mix of finishes will be used for a modern look.
raw.loft_why: The customer wants tall storage, so lofts will be included above the wall cabinets.
